removed_uncertainties.text: Line 8, וְדַעְתָּךְ: the consonants ודעתך are clear. The pointing (vav vowel, tav vowel) is not.
Line 5, הַשָּׁמָֽיִם: I read qamatz (pausal), but it could be patah.
Line 12, בְּלִי כֹל: I don't see a dagesh. Line 20, פָעָלְתָּ: there may be a dagesh in the pe.
Line 9: in יָעַֽפְתָּ / יָגַֽעְתָּ, the meteg could be on the first syllable instead of the second.
Line 9, בִמְלַאכְתְּךָ: I don't see a dagesh in the bet.
I didn't individually confirm the metegs on this page.

retained_as_source_observations.text: The parentheticals (נ״א אַף) and (מַֽיִם) are pointed. (נ״א כלי) is unpointed.
'הם הם': the word is clearly printed twice. Kept as printed.
'בחוק' and 'בחק': spelled differently as printed. Kept.
Some words are set in heavier type (לא בגדר ולא, שהוא אדם לבן, ושלש מדות). This looks like uneven inking, not deliberate emphasis.
